name: New Mexico
status_why: The CSV exports answered scripts; the kit already reads them.
office: the New Mexico Secretary of State
system: Secretary of State's own ASP.NET results site on Azure Government (electionresults.sos.nm.gov, server volt-adc; data service nmresultswebservice.azurewebsites.us). Same platform family as Nebraska's.

results_page.label: New Mexico Secretary of State: election results
results_page.source: answered one request with the kit's User-Agent (N4, 2026-10-10)

election.how_to_find: Check once a week whether eid=2917 opens.

feeds.address: https://electionresults.sos.nm.gov/resultsCSV.aspx?text=All&type=FED&map=CTY&eid=<eid> (type codes SW statewide, FED, LGX legislative, JDX district judges, MGX magistrates, JMC Bernalillo Metropolitan Court, ECX Public Education Commission, MUX municipal)
feeds.updates: as counties upload on election night
feeds.note: The kit reads the primary export (eid 2911). Pages HTTP 200 on 2026-10-09. Columns include CandidateAbsenteeVotes, CandidateElectionDayVotes, CandidateEarlyVotes and PrecinctsReporting.

feeds.address: https://nmresultswebservice.azurewebsites.us/NMResultsAjax.svc/GetMapDataArchive?type=<code>&category=CTY (archive; the live method name to confirm)
feeds.note: The kit's loader uses this to check county sums.

races_in_feed: county offices ('Offices and Questions by County')
municipal offices in elections that carry them
local: No need for state and county offices (the state site carries them). Bernalillo County Clerk (bernco.gov/clerk) also posts. Not requested.
how_counted: New Mexico reports absentee, early and Election Day votes separately.
vote_types: Yes: absentee, early and election-day votes per candidate in the CSV.

certify.body: the New Mexico State Canvassing Board
certify.rule: Declares the results on the third Tuesday after the election (N.M. Stat. 1-13-15).
certify.local_rule: County boards between the 6th and 10th day (13th in the largest counties) (1-13-13).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_blocked: Nothing refused. A missing eid redirects to www.sos.nm.gov.
scout_plan: Check once a week whether eid=2917 opens. On election night read the CSV exports for SW, FED, LGX and the court and county types every few minutes; the vote-type columns feed the count-order predictor directly. The reader in nm.py already handles this format.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
